{{Quote|Hey, you! Identify yourself!|The squad leader, to Bodhi Rook|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
A '''human''' [[Gender|male]] served as a [[coastal defender stormtrooper]] [[squad leader]] in the [[Scarif Deployment]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. The [[trooper]] led a [[Unidentified shoretrooper squad|squad]] of other coastal defender stormtroopers, who were able to pinpoint the infiltration point of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rogue One]] team. The squad leader found [[Bodhi Rook]] and ordered him to identify himself, but was [[Death|killed]] by other rebels while the rest of his [[squad]] was ambushed.<ref name="Rogue One" />
